title: MACE example suite
provenance: Output files are unmodified copies of CRYSTAL23 runs by the Mendoza group (the group's own data, shared for use with MACE), of files in MACE's tests/data, or of CRYSTAL23 runs made for this suite on the MSU HPCC from the decks next to them; each file's origin is in `source`. Wavefunction (fort.9) and scratch files are not included. Input decks marked "written by mace" were generated from those outputs by MACE itself. Cube grids are decimated by 2 along each axis (by 4 for the polyacetylene grids, 100 x 518 x 404 points in CRYSTAL's run). The diamond decks embed a published pob-TZVP-type carbon basis set.

entries.title: Sodalite framework, pure silica (idealized)
entries.notes: The corpus holds no porous MOF/COF/zeolite output, so every run here was made on the MSU HPCC for this suite. The start geometry is the ideal SOD net (all Si-O 1.610 A, tetrahedral), optimized by the OPT run; cages of about 5.5 A diameter. SP runs at the OPT geometry and the BAND, DOSS, TRANSPORT and CHARGE+POTENTIAL runs read its wavefunction.

entries.title: Graphene monolayer (compact cell)
entries.method: HSEsol-3c / SOLDEF2MSVP, SLAB (layer group 80), spin-polarized, SMEAR 0.001 Ha
entries.notes: Two atoms: every run here takes minutes. A semimetal: Fermi smearing and Broyden mixing in the SP deck (and the OPT deck written from it) are what let its SCF converge; the BAND, DOSS, TRANSPORT and CHARGE+POTENTIAL decks read the SP wavefunction. The full-coverage 2D entry is h-BN.

SP.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite; graphene a = 2.4612 A as a SLAB in layer group 80, spin-polarized; Fermi smearing 0.001 Ha and Broyden mixing, without which graphene's SCF oscillated

OPT.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite

FREQ.reason: no usable FREQ for this semimetal: without Fermi smearing its SCF oscillates (the FREQ run stopped with SCF ENDED - TOO MANY CYCLES at 200 cycles), and with smearing CRYSTAL23's analytic gradients, from which FREQCALC builds the Hessian, are not reliable for a conducting system (CRYSTAL23 manual, SMEAR, p.127). FREQ runs from smeared SPs (Broyden mixing) gave the E2g (G) mode at 235 cm-1 with SMEAR 0.005 and at -719 cm-1 with SMEAR 0.001, where graphene's is near 1580 cm-1, so no FREQ deck or output is shipped

entries.notes: A conjugated polymer with alternating single and double bonds, 4 atoms per repeat, the suite's full-coverage 1D entry. entries.title: Ethylene carbonate (isolated molecule)
entries.notes: A 10-atom organic carbonate (a Li-ion electrolyte solvent), the suite's full-coverage 0D entry: the group's OPT run, then SP from it and every other calculation from that SP, all decks written by MACE.

SP.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite; at the optimized geometry; spin-polarized, closed shell (alpha = beta)

FREQ.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite; 158 to 3123 cm-1, all real (C=O stretch 1987 cm-1); IR and Raman spectra

PHONON_DOS.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite; the Gamma-only phonon DOS of the molecule (manual p.236), 0-4000 cm-1, 200 bins: 3N = 30 states

CPHF.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite; polarizability tensor, mean alpha 35.5 bohr^3 (no dielectric tensor for a molecule)

CHARGE+POTENTIAL.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite; from the SP wavefunction; the spin density is zero everywhere (a closed-shell result), so its SPIN cube is not shipped

ORBITALS.note: run on the MSU HPCC for this suite; the ALPHA orbitals pass the GUI's orthonormality check; CRYSTAL23 writes the BETA coefficients of this spin-polarized closed-shell run as zeros, so only ALPHA is drawn (alpha = beta here)

BAND.reason: a molecule has no band structure (CRYSTAL23 manual, BAND: "does not run for molecules", p.309)

DOSS.reason: CRYSTAL computes no density of states for a molecule (CRYSTAL23 manual, DOSS: "do not run for molecules", p.320)

TRANSPORT.reason: BOLTZTRA's transport distribution function sums band velocities over the k points of the Brillouin zone (CRYSTAL23 manual, eq. 14.4, p.314), and a molecule has no bands (BAND: "does not run for molecules", p.309)

PHONON_BAND.reason: a phonon dispersion samples k points defined by a SCELPHONO supercell of a 1D, 2D or 3D periodic system (CRYSTAL23 manual, pp.232-233; SCELPHONO takes a 3D, 2D or 1D expansion matrix, p.73); CRYSTAL23 stops a MOLECULE at SCELPHONO (SUPERCELL OPTION NOT ALLOWED FOR MOLECULES)

ELASTIC.reason: elastic constants are strain derivatives along the periodic directions, and the elements of a non-periodic direction are null by definition (CRYSTAL23 manual, ch. 13, p.288): a molecule has none; a probe run of ELASTCON on EC stopped with "SYSTEM MUST BE PERIODIC FOR ELAPIEZO"

EOS.reason: EOS scans the cell volume with volume-constrained optimizations (CRYSTAL23 manual, ch. 12, p.282), which CRYSTAL23 runs for 3D systems only (p.12: "Constant volume or pressure constrained geometry optimizations (3D only)"); a molecule has no cell volume

QHA.reason: QHA fits phonon frequencies against the cell volume, relaxing the structure at each volume (CRYSTAL23 manual, sec. 9.2, p.253); it is generalized to 1D and 2D systems (p.14), not to molecules: a probe run of QHA on EC stopped with "ELASTIC OPTION NOT ALLOWED FOR MOLECULES"
